data.title: PTT announces CEO and president recruitment
data.description: PTT Public Company Limited (PTT) has announced a public invite of applications for the position of chief executive officer and president in accordance with its nomination procedure.

data.title: Crisis at MGI with a 92.6% drop in its shares forces Nawat to account to the SEC
data.description: The fall from the peak, the legal claims and the investment of 135 million baht in Sabuy place MGI’s management before questions that deserve a documentary examination.

data.title: Global Executives Discuss Job Creation & Workforce Skills in AI Economy
data.description: Senior executives from the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group, Standard Chartered Bank, Microsoft Asia and Accenture discussed economic growth in the age of AI at the panel discussion “Powering The Future Economy – Growth, Technology, and Sustainability”. The discussion was part of “KBank x Techsauce: EMPOWER THE FUTURE ECONOMY”, organised by KASIKORNBANK (KBank) in collaboration with Techsauce as an affiliated program held in conjunction with the IMF–World Bank Group Annual Meetings 2026, hosted by Thailand.

data.title: OCEAN LIFE reimagines insurance for the living
data.description: Thailand’s insurance industry has demonstrated resilience amid global uncertainties through the second quarter of 2026, with the t otal life insurance premiums in the first half in 2026 reached THB 341.52 billion, up 4.57% year on year, in which the Thai Life Assurance Association forecasting full-year growth of 2.5–3.5%. Against this challenging backdrop, OCEAN LIFE INSURANCE is seeing a shift in consumer awareness, with life insurance increasingly linked to digitalisation, longer and healthier lives and more sophisticated wealth management.

data.title: Germany–Japan–Thailand Investment Corridor Could Unlock Thai Industrial Growth
data.description: Thailand could gain new investment, cleaner industrial technology and stronger regional supply chains through closer cooperation with Germany and Japan, provided the three countries translate shared ambitions into commercially viable projects.

data.title: Gaysorn Group wins Marshall Goldsmith Coaching Culture Excellence Award Thailand 2026
data.description: Gaysorn Group has received the “Marshall Goldsmith Coaching Culture Excellence Award Thailand 2026,” presented by Dr Marshall Goldsmith in collaboration with ITD World, the award organiser and endorsed by a panel of global experts. As the first and only organisation in Thailand to receive this distinction, Gaysorn Group has demonstrated its commitment to developing people’s capabilities and growth, while embedding a coaching culture into everyday work to build high-performance teams and drive sustainable growth.

data.title: Record-Low Top University Acceptance Rates
data.description: Gaining admission to world-class universities like the Ivy League, Stanford, or Oxbridge today is no longer just a competition of academic excellence. No matter how stellar a student's grades are, the risk of rejection remains. With top-tier applicants possessing remarkably similar abilities, the deciding factor is no longer who is smarter, but "who has a clearer and more standout identity."

data.title: SBS Rangsit Launches International Bilingual Model for Thai Students
data.description: As Thailand’s international education market grows, SBS International Bilingual School Rangsit is advancing an approach designed to bridge international academic standards with the language skills, cultural understanding and practical experience students need for their futures in Thailand and around the world.

data.title: NBTC Symposium 2026 tackles digital resilience and emerging technologies
data.description: On October 8–9, 2026, the Office of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC), through the International Academic Affairs Bureau under the Academic Affairs Division, successfully hosted the NBTC Symposium 2026 at the Viman Room, Dusit Thani Bangkok Hotel. The opening ceremony was presided over by Ms. Korkanok Kijbanjai, Principal Policy and Planning Expert with Ramida Leelapata, Assistant Secretary General of Academic Cluster delivering the reporting overview. The event convened ambassadors and members of the diplomatic corps in Thailand, representatives from international organizations, government agencies, the private sector, academic institutions, as well as NBTC executives and personnel. The symposium served as a high-level platform for knowledge exchange and vision sharing among senior executives from leading domestic and international public and private sectors, under the theme “Beyond Volatility: Harnessing Resilience Through Dialogue.”

data.title: The 1 Central Group unveils megatrends shaping Asian retail at World Retail Lab Asia 2026
data.description: The 1 Central Group, Thailand’s No. 1 digital lifestyle and loyalty platform and one of Asia’s top five,participated in the opening panel discussion of World Retail Lab Asia 2026 in Hong Kong. Kawin Tangudtaisak, President of The 1 Central Group, shared perspectives from Thailand and Southeast Asia, highlighting four key megatrends expected to shape Asia’s retail landscape toward 2030. His insights emphasised a shift from sales-driven growth toward delivering meaningful customer value, leveraging technology strategically and building enduring customer relationships. His participation further strengthened The 1 Central Group’s international presence, following its participation in the World Retail Congress in Berlin, Germany.

data.title: Gourmet Market and Gourmet Eats at Terminal 21 Asok unveil a new look
data.description: Gourmet Market, the world-class gourmet destination, and Gourmet Eats , a curated dining destination catering to every lifestyle under The Mall Group, have unveiled the newly transformed Terminal 21 Asok branch in Bangkok following its first major renovation in 15 years. Reimagined under the concept “Endless and Unlike Any Other Supermarket & Food Experience,” the destination evolves beyond a premium supermarket into a vibrant food and lifestyle hub in the heart of Sukhumvit, catering to modern urban consumers and international visitors seeking convenience, discovery and inspiration through food in a single destination.

data.title: PTTEP wins Human Rights Role Model award for 3rd consecutive year
data.description: PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited (PTTEP), represented by Mrs. Susama Pitakuldilog, Senior Vice-President of the Sustainability and Stakeholder Management Division, received the “Human Rights Role Model Organization” award for 2026 at the Top-Tier Gold level (highest level), in the State Enterprise category. The accolade was presented by Police Lieutenant General Rutthaphon Naowarat, Minister of Justice, at the Human Rights Awards 2026 ceremony organized by the Rights and Liberties Protection Department, Ministry of Justice. PTTEP has received the Human Rights Role Model Organization award for eight consecutive years, achieving the Top-Tier Gold level for the third consecutive year.

data.title: Empowering Tomorrow: Bosch Crowns Winners of INNOVISION YOUNG GEN 2026
data.description: Nationwide Youth Engagement: Nearly 400 high school and university applicants submitted UN SDG-aligned concepts, with 40 shortlisted finalists completing an intensive systems-thinking and sensor-based technology workshop.

data.title: Betagro Acquires a Majority Stake in Freshket, Thailand’s Leading Digital Food Supply Platform
data.description: Bangkok – October 20, 2026 – Betagro Public Company Limited (SET: BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand, today announced that it has acquired a majority stake in Freshket, Thailand’s leading digital food supply platform for the hotel, restaurant and catering (HORECA) sector. The investment was made through Betagro Ventures. Financial terms were not disclosed.

data.title: Caltex invests over 500 million baht in seamless digitalisation
data.description: Caltex officially launches “ Kebdao”, a new loyalty platform designed to connect customer experiences at every touchpoint, from re-fueling and non-oil services to rewards and exclusive offers through a digital platform. As part of its long-term strategy, Caltex has allocated over 500 million baht for seamless digitalisation & Infrastructure upgrade project from 2026 to 2030, covering digital backbone development, a complete overhaul of its digital network infrastructure, and loyalty program management. This investment will, on one hand, lay the foundation for the new loyalty platform and on the other, support the expansion of services and its long-term loyalty ecosystem. Caltex aims to double its “Kebdao” membership base to 1.5 million within 2030.

data.title: IMF-World Bank meeting explores how creative IP can boost Thai content globally
data.description: The Creative Economy Agency (Public Organisation) or CEA, hosted “CREATIVITY AS CAPITAL: Driving the Next Growth Frontier” as an official Affiliated Programme of the 2026 IMF–World Bank Group Annual Meetings. The programme featured a forum titled “From Creative Capital to Global Asset,” that brought together perspectives from international executives and leading creative content industry figures on how creative intellectual property (IP) can evolve from creative works into high-value assets capable of attracting investment, generating economic value and enabling businesses to scale into global markets.

data.title: CEA Drives Thailand’s IP Finance Ecosystem Towards Global Growth
data.description: The Creative Economy Agency (Public Organization), or CEA, hosted “CREATIVITY AS CAPITAL: Driving the Next Growth Frontier”as an Official Affiliated Programme of the 2026 IMF–World Bank Group Annual Meetings. The programme featured a forum titled “Building the Enabling Environment: Policy Platforms and Intensives for a Competitive Creative Sector ,” sharing perspectives for creating friendly ecosystem that facilitates Thailand’s creative industry. It has included other essential instruments such as financial system development, IP for asset, foreign investment promotion, paving a way for local content creators to connect with the global markets.

data.title: Ngern Tid Lor receives 2026 SEC Certificate for promoting financial literacy
data.description: Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited , a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , led by Nipa Vanichavat , Head of Corporate Sustainability, represented the company in receiving the certificate of recognition as an “Organisation Promoting Financial and Investment Literacy among Employees” under the 2026 Financial Well-being in Workplace Programme, organised by Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), in collaboration with the Thai Listed Companies Association.
